findings.explanation: HOL4 defines FAPPLY f x = OUTL (fmap_REP f x). Outside FDOM f this is OUTL (INR one). OUTL's only saved defining equation is OUTL (INL x) = x (sumScript.sml:286, via new_specification), so that value is unspecified; HOL4 proves only f ' x = FEMPTY ' x there (NOT_FDOM_FAPPLY_FEMPTY). The Lean match returns ARB for none, so Lean proves FAPPLY FEMPTY x = ARB, and hence also FAPPLY FEMPTY x = THE none and = HD []. The theorems HOL4 saves leave these open. Values on the domain agree.
findings.repair:
noncomputable opaque OUTL_INR_one {β : Type} [Nonempty β] : β

def FAPPLY [Nonempty β] (f : fmap α β) (x : α) : β :=
  match f.rep x with
  | some y => y
  | none => OUTL_INR_one
findings.lean_check:
import CmlTS.Prelude.FiniteMap

namespace CmlTS

example {α β : Type} [Nonempty β] (x : α) : FAPPLY (FEMPTY : fmap α β) x = ARB := rfl

example {α β : Type} [Nonempty β] (x : α) : FAPPLY (FEMPTY : fmap α β) x = THE none := rfl

end CmlTS
findings.hol4_check: !(f:'a |-> 'b) x. ~(x IN FDOM f) ==> (FAPPLY f x = FAPPLY FEMPTY x)
